strip_lines: whole-line substrings to drop while cleaning
usage.expect: OPTIONAL substring that must appear in the captured panel; if absent, capture errors out telling the user to initialize/trust this folder (readiness gate)
usage.calculation: EXPR yielding remaining_pct from the captured 'value' (e.g. '100 - float(str(value).strip('%'))' when the CLI prints percent USED; 'float(str(value).strip('%'))' when it already prints percent LEFT)

PERIOD_NAME (e.g., weekly).pct: REGEX capturing the percentage the CLI prints, used or left (one group)
PERIOD_NAME (e.g., weekly).resets: REGEX capturing the reset time (one group)

list_cmd: models (OPTIONAL: non-interactive id source; if set, capture runs this subcommand instead of driving the TUI)
models.expect: OPTIONAL substring that must appear in the captured text; if absent, capture errors out (readiness gate, e.g. not initialized / not logged in / folder not trusted)
models.list_start: OPTIONAL substring where the model list begins (omit to scan whole text)
models.list_end: OPTIONAL substring where the model list ends
models.list_regex: PER-LINE REGEX. Named groups (?P<id>...) / (?P<name>...): id = the --model parameter, name = friendly label. A single capture group is used for both (the label IS the id, e.g. codex).
models.id_case: OPTIONAL: lower or upper-case normalization for executable model ids; display names are preserved
